lead.event: TPIA ends buyback and announces replacement Rp2 trillion program
lead.headline: TPIA ends Rp1 trillion buyback, announces Rp2 trillion replacement program
lead.blurb: Chandra Asri Pacific ended its earlier repurchase plan on 28 October after changing the allocation amount. The plan began on 19 October and was originally set to run through 31 December, allowing purchases of up to 0.92% of issued shares at Rp1,250–Rp3,000 each, funded from internal cash. BCA Sekuritas was appointed to carry out the new program, for which no further dates were provided.

deals_control.event: DSSA buys Rp3.1 trillion BSD City land for data center expansion
deals_control.headline: DSSA agrees to buy Rp3.1 trillion of BSD City land for data center expansion
deals_control.blurb: Dian Swastatika Sentosa signed an agreement on 26 October to acquire 166,261 square metres from Surya Inter Wisesa, a Bumi Serpong Damai subsidiary. The land in BSD City's D-Hub Special Economic Zone is intended to support new data center development, and the deal is an affiliated transaction because both groups are part of Sinar Mas.

deals_control.event: Bank Mandiri sells Inhealth stake to IFG Life for Rp570 billion
deals_control.headline: BMRI agrees to sell Inhealth stake to IFG Life for Rp570 billion
deals_control.blurb: Bank Mandiri signed a conditional agreement on 26 October to transfer its 20% stake, comprising 200,000 shares, to IFG Life. Completion depends on required approvals, after which Bank Mandiri will exit Inhealth and IFG Life will own all of it.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: EMAS secures US$435 million loan facility
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS secures US$435 million loan facility
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The agreement dated 26 October includes a US$150 million term loan and a revolving facility of up to US$285 million. Unsecured and due on 26 October 2031, the facility will help Merdeka Gold repay debt, fund capital expenditure and transaction costs, provide intragroup funding, manage rupiah bond payments and cover working capital.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: NexAI Digital schedules Rp2.53 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MGLV schedules Rp2.53 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: NexAI Digital will issue 285.73 million shares at Rp8,880 each, at 15 rights for every 100 shares. Majority shareholder Nextier Datamate Center, which holds 62.71%, says it will exercise all its entitlements, worth about Rp1.59 trillion. Cum rights trading in regular and negotiation markets starts 4 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BNI announces Rp547 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBNI announces Rp547 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BNI will fund the three-month program entirely from internal cash, with estimated broker commissions and other costs capped at 0.30% of the buyback value. It says the buyback will not materially affect operating costs, business activity or net profit, while assets and equity are expected to decline slightly. The program runs through 27 January 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: BRMS returns to quarterly profit as nine-month earnings decline
earnings_guidance.headline: BRMS returns to quarterly profit at US$11.01 million as nine-month earnings fall 35.4%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi Resources Minerals' Q3 revenue rose to US$71.79 million from US$26.32 million quarter-on-quarter, with gold sales of 16,748 ounces and ore grade of 1.94 grams per ton at Poboya. January-September net profit was US$24.29 million, while revenue fell to US$167.58 million from US$183.58 million.

earnings_guidance.headline: COIN reports Rp40.78 billion nine-month net loss
earnings_guidance.blurb: The loss compares with Rp25.51 billion profit a year earlier, while basic loss per share was Rp2.77 versus earnings of Rp2.04. Indokripto’s revenue fell 34.78% to Rp73.78 billion, while general and administrative expenses rose to Rp121.47 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: HMSP reports higher nine-month 2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: HMSP reports 9M 2026 net profit up 44.42% to Rp6.51 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net sales increased 4.5% to Rp87.51 trillion, while machine-made kretek cigarette sales rose to Rp52.51 trillion from Rp45.43 trillion. Mirae Asset’s Nafan Aji Gusta Utama recommended accumulating Sampoerna shares, with targets of Rp700 short term and Rp780 long term, and said growth depends on efficiency, product mix and certainty on 2027 tobacco excise policy.

earnings_guidance.event: Indosat reports higher nine-month 2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: ISAT reports 37.20% rise in nine-month net profit to Rp4.92 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: The increase was in profit attributable to parent owners, from Rp3.56 trillion a year earlier. Revenue rose 11.15% to Rp45.75 trillion, basic earnings per share increased 37.21% to Rp152.62, and investment totaled Rp15 trillion.
